name: s3Delete
syntax: s3Delete(bucketName [, objectName, force, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Deletes an S3 bucket, or an object in it. Without `objectName`, the bucket is deleted. A bucket that isn't empty needs `force=true`.

params.name: objectName
params.description: The object key. When omitted, the bucket is deleted.

params.name: force
params.description: When true, a bucket that isn't empty is emptied and deleted.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. Returns nothing. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: Delete a single object
examples.description: Removes one key from the bucket.

examples.title: Delete a bucket and its contents
examples.description: force=true empties the bucket before deleting it.
